name: Fitipower Integrated Technology Inc.
summary: Fitipower Integrated Technology Inc. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of display screen integrated circuits (ICs) and power management ICs in Taiwan. It offers LCD driver, LED driver, and E paper display driver ICs; and power management IC products comprising EPD panel power, switching regulator, LED driver, motor driver IC, USB power switch IC, reset IC, Li-on charger IC, and low dropout regulator; and other related semiconductor solutions.
